as_of.description: when the standing was last asserted by the org — the read-time clock for every derived status

classifications.description: the declared levels on one scheme, e.g. the NPS `A`/`B`/`F`/`R` level set

completed_at.description: when the org finished the standing wizard

contract_value_range.description: the org's declared typical contract value range

declared.description: self-declared by the org, as opposed to evidenced

effective_from.description: the date the declared standing took effect

evidence_id.description: the evidence artefact backing the adherence claim

expires_at.description: when the holding or the next evidence obligation lapses

fact_key.description: the per-record key inside the kind: `profile`, `scheme:{scheme_key}`, `obligation:{obligation_key}`, the requirement key

is_active.description: whether the org still carries the obligation (inactive rows are kept visible, never retired)

jurisdictions.description: the jurisdictions the org declares it operates/contracts in

max_contract_value.description: the largest contract value the org declares it can take

next_due.description: when the obligation next falls due

obligation_key.description: stable key for a recurring obligation: catalog `id` for a template, `custom:{slug}` for a user-added one

requirement_id.description: the clause/scheme-requirement identifier being adhered to

scheme_key.description: the catalog scheme/panel this row belongs to (`nps`, `iso45001`, …, or `panel:{key}`)

shelf_type.description: the concrete pattern instance `compliance_state:{record_kind}:{fact_key}`; today the **only** carrier of the record kind and the per-record key

source.description: provenance of the obligation row (`template` today)

source_id.description: the idempotency key the writer mints (today `shelf_type` + fact key + the `accept_fact` date part)

source_system.description: the writer identity; `DEMITON` for all four kinds today

status.description: the standing's own state; today `scheme.status` defaults `"active"` (`:245`) and `requirement.status` is free-ish with `not_assessed` expressed as absence (`:1523-1528`)

subject_entity_id.description: the org the standing belongs to; the shared subject of all four kinds

title.description: the human name of the obligation/requirement (for a scheme, its catalog label)

valid_until.description: supersession stamp; the live row is `valid_until IS NULL`
